title: Build Your Own Prompt Blueprint
description: Construct a complete prompt from scratch using all four components.
problemStatement:
Imagine you want an AI to create a weekly meal plan for a vegetarian family of four, with a focus on quick recipes (under 30 minutes). 

Write a single prompt that clearly includes:
- Instruction
- Context (persona, audience, etc.)
- Input Data (you can invent a sample day or list available ingredients)
- Output Indicator (format, length, style)

After writing, label each component in your prompt. Then reflect: which component most influenced the final structure?
hints: Instruction: Could be 'Create a weekly meal plan'.
Input Data: List 10 common vegetarian ingredients they have.
Output Indicator: 'Present as a markdown table with columns for Day, Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner, and Prep Time.'
expectedOutput:
A prompt like:

'[Instruction] Create a 7‑day vegetarian meal plan. [Context] You are a nutritionist helping a busy family of four. [Input Data] Available ingredients: eggs, spinach, chickpeas, quinoa, tomatoes, bell peppers, tofu, pasta, lentils, cheese. [Output Indicator] Output as a markdown table with columns: Day, Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner, Prep Time (min). Keep all prep times under 30 minutes.'

Your analysis should label and discuss the impact of each component.
solutionCode: // No code; this is a manual construction and reflection.
